positioning.audience: Swiss and DACH B2B leaders at companies with 50 to 500 people.
positioning.coreProblem: Salesforce, ERP, inboxes, and Excel carry the same operational work without one reliable view.
positioning.commercialMotion: Recognition first, trust second, conversation third.
positioning.primaryConversion: Contact form conversation about the stuck process.

shortTerm.objective: Build topical authority and recognition around integration, manual work, data reliability, and operational control.
successSignals: Consistent weekly content shipped for review
Every post mapped to one funnel stage
Every post published in English, German, and Spanish
Every weekly package has one blog cover and five distinct LinkedIn images

mediumTerm.objective: Create content paths that help leaders diagnose their own systems before contacting Osmel.
successSignals: At least one cluster for integration risk
At least one cluster for process automation
At least one cluster for data reliability and AI readiness
Internal links connect posts to related services and tools

longTerm.objective: Turn the site into a quiet sales funnel where readers move from recognition to a concrete conversation.
successSignals: Service pages supported by diagnostic articles
Content linked to one clear next step
Search Console insights used to prioritize future topics
Spanish and German content parity maintained

awareness.purpose: Help the reader recognize a painful operating pattern.
awareness.readerQuestion: Why does this keep happening in my company?

diagnosis.purpose: Give the reader a practical way to inspect the problem.
diagnosis.readerQuestion: How do I know whether this applies to us?

consideration.purpose: Show what a controlled, maintainable solution should look like.
consideration.readerQuestion: What should we ask for before we buy or build?

conversion.purpose: Make a direct conversation feel like the natural next step.
conversion.readerQuestion: Who can help us understand the bottleneck and decide what to fix first?

blog.rule: One logical article translated into all supported languages and mapped to one funnel stage and one content pillar.

linkedin.rule: Only the blog-share draft links to the weekly article. The other four drafts are standalone insights.

images.rule: Every entry has its own production-ready image. Images are not reused within the weekly package.

rotationRules: Do not publish two consecutive weekly posts in the same pillar unless Search Console data supports it.
Alternate problem recognition with diagnostic or consideration content.
Use the weekly LinkedIn distribution: two awareness posts, one diagnosis post, one consideration post, and one blog share.
Avoid invented client evidence, statistics, testimonials, or results.
Prefer concrete operating nouns: order, quote, approval, month-end, Excel, ERP, inbox.
Each post must point to one clear next step rather than multiple competing CTAs.
